abstract: A case of congenital immature gastric teratoma along with spontaneous gastric perforation in a 1-day-old boy is presented. The clinical features are similar to those of meconium peritonitis. Coincidentally, the child had an arachnoid cyst at 25 months of age. To the best of the authors knowledge, this case of congenital immature gastric teratoma associated with gastric perforation mimicking meconium peritonitis, is the first description in the English-language literature.
abstract_ja: 生後1日の男児に、先天性未熟胃奇形腫と自然発生的な胃穿孔を認めた症例を報告する。臨床像は胎便性腹膜炎に類似していた。偶然にも、この児は25か月齢時に蜘蛛膜嚢胞を有していた。著者らの知る限り、胎便性腹膜炎に類似した先天性未熟胃奇形腫と胃穿孔の併存は、英語文献で初めての報告である。
